# Fresco

> Fresco is an AI weekly menu planner: it generates a realistic weekly menu and an aisle-grouped shopping list in under 30 seconds, and gets better every week by learning from which recipes a household actually cooks versus discards.

Fresco is not a recipe-discovery app, a pantry/inventory manager, or a price comparator. It solves a planning and decision-fatigue problem: turning "what do I cook this week?" into a full week of meals and a shopping list, repeated every week, with less effort each time.

## Product

- [Home](/): Guest landing page — value proposition, how it works, pricing, FAQ. Try a first menu with no signup required.
- [Onboarding](/onboarding): 3-step setup (diet, favorite cuisines, household size) that generates a first weekly menu without creating an account.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a Fresco account to save menus and unlock the Pro learning loop.
- [Log in](/login): Access an existing Fresco account.

## Core features

- AI-generated weekly menu (21 meals) in under 30 seconds.
- Editable calendar with drag-and-drop meal swaps.
- Shopping list automatically grouped by supermarket aisle.
- "Cooked / discarded" feedback per recipe — the signal behind Pro's week-over-week learning.
- Manual food-safety review for allergies and dietary restrictions on every generated menu.

## Plans

- Free (€0/month): one AI-generated weekly menu and shopping list per week, generated from scratch each time.
- Pro (€4.99/month): everything in Free, plus behavioral learning — Fresco avoids recipes the household discarded, prioritizes ones they cooked, and adjusts quantities over time. 7-day free trial, no card required upfront.

## Optional

- Fresco explicitly does not do: receipt scanning, pantry/inventory management, price comparison, or a recipe marketplace.
